assumptions: Workers are trusted to remain in their initial process group; deliberate detachment and uncatchable termination before durable registration are excluded.

The caller must hold the single-writer lock through launch, cleanup and recovery, and on_spawn must durably record ownership before returning. Those call sites and the registration implementation are not supplied.
Callers must supply finite positive time allowances and valid absolute deadlines; bounded_process does not validate these inputs.
checks: Reviewed the supplied launch, signal masking, cleanup, recovery, locking and clock code without tools.
Checked ordinary interruption handling, leader identity preservation, PID-reuse defenses, recovery vetoes and absolute-deadline enforcement.
The packet reports 197 passing tests. Test bodies were not supplied, so names and counts do not establish coverage of individual interleavings or accounting correctness.
issues: bounded_process launches before checking whether its absolute cutoff has already passed or stopped() already returns true. It calculates cutoff, writes the prompt, opens files and executes Popen; only the subsequent wait loop evaluates those conditions. Consequently, a deadline or stop request arriving during preparation can still start an editable worker, which can change files before termination. Returning timeout or stop_requested afterward does not undo those effects. This conflicts with the reviewed requirement that insufficient budget and observed stop requests prevent worker launch. Repair: recheck the absolute cutoff and stop callback immediately before Popen, after preparation, and return an explicit not-launched outcome without invoking on_spawn when either condition applies. Ensure callers preserve that outcome without treating it as an executed retry. Keep the existing post-launch checks for events arriving after the launch decision.
next_actions: Add the final prelaunch deadline and stop checks and define how callers handle a not-launched result.

Add focused regression coverage for a deadline expiring during preparation and a stop becoming observable during preparation; verify that Popen and on_spawn are not called and no editable attempt is consumed.
